My son loves me again!. Great product! My older son busted my younger son's screen and the world nearly came to an end. Daddy is now the hero who brought the iPad back to life. Looks exactly the same as the original but with out all the sticky finger prints. After looking at a few helpful YouTube videos, the repair was pretty straight forward and surprisingly easy. 6/18/16 Update - a few weeks ago my son's iPad developed an odd symptom. It appears to be haunted, what happens is the thing will randomly open apps and launch things in the apps. When he plays MineCraft, the iPad builds and destroys things in an area he didn't select...which naturally drives him nuts. The iPad doesn't do it all the time but enough to be a real issue. I have reached out to MMOBIEL and their suggestion was to heat the digitizer up and reset the pins in the connector and if I wasn't comfortable doing that to take it a professional....well, I haven't done it yet and while I have no plans to pay a professional, I am worried the screen will shatter and that the adhesive won't seal correctly after. Maybe they are right, maybe the connection is not set properly but I would think the symptoms would be more consistent if that was the case. I plan to try it soon, guess we shall see.

Great sound. We have about half a dozen headphones in our house. In general, I find a lot of headphones are comparable lately. They all tend to come with a carrying case of some sort now (this one has a drawstring case). They all tend to have a mic now (this one does in one of the cords it comes with -- so it's at least compatible with most if not all phones you're likely to have). They all do something to stand out using unique colors or shapes (this one has a somewhat triangular shape and skins are available). Which leaves where they must stand out -- sound and fit. Sound wise, these are the best in our house. I won't bother listing all of the others we have but they're all in the $100-200 range I believe. For the most part they have all sounded alike. Not being a super audiophile, I have not minded that they all tend to sound the same. These though do sound crisper. The hubby put them on to play one of his online games (a lot going on with chats and action here and there) and immediately announced that they changed the gameplay for him. So sound, these are a winner in that department. They're also great a blocking sound. Fit? This one is tougher. I am quite picky having a lot of ear troubles and headaches. They fit me fine but don't seem as comfy for extended use. As I said though, I am picky with plenty of issues that headphones add to, so that one aspect of them was more like a 3-4 while retaining an overall 5. *UPDATE* April 20, 2014 - The cover over the foam on the ears has started to pull away. They're only used a few hours a week, so this probably shouldn't happen within 2 months. They're still our faves but now we're worried about long they'll hold up. *UPDATE* August 23, 2014 - While we still love these headphones, the band cracked while other older headphones we've used more have held up just fine. So without the breaks easy factor my review was 5 stars, now it's more like 3 as they just don't hold up to normal use for very long.
